notes.title: Major Price Update/Discounted
notes.notes:
I wanted to lower the price of the game to $5 because it occured to me that the price might be too high and games are less popular of a commodity or something. I am deeply disappointed that I had to discount and not even one person bought for that reason of being less popular.



The game is pretty fun and I don't care if you don't like it. I just don't want to kill my game.

STOP KILLING GAMES legit.

End of story. So keep playing games and please buy this game from me. I developed it in 2019 and it was laborious to make. I cannot update any further since it is already finished just the way it was meant to be.

The game is a Windows PC Game. Please don't harass/defame. That is not the intent of this post.
